name: Aquatic Reproduction, Eggs, Nurseries & Life Cycle Runtime
design_rules: spawning requires mature adults and a suitable nursery habitat
eggs transition to juveniles only after species incubation time
juveniles mature only after species-specific development time
juvenile mortality is reduced by cover and parental care
strong current or unsuitable depth can suppress spawning
population growth becomes spatially tied to nursery quality
life-cycle state persists across world days
aquatic reproduction never uses emissive or glow feedback
